notes.title: PLAYTEST BUILD 0.9.35.5 | New rooms, items and an enemy
notes.content:
[p]Hi!

This will be the last content patch before a demo release. This update brings in two new rooms to spice up your rounds and removes some old ones that did not have unique properties. Also, there's a few new items and a new deadly enemy.

[b]New content:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] New room: Sheriff’s Office. This room has surveillance equipment that players can use to monitor CCTV Cameras across the station. If this room is spawned while there is a Sheriff in the current round, the sheriff is granted a key to unlock a special safe in the room containing random sheriff equipment.
[/p][/*][*][p] New room: Intercom. Transmit your voice to loudspeakers all over the station using the equipment in this room.
[/p][/*][*][p] New enemy: Maw. Fast and challenging enemy with a weakness to light.
[/p][/*][*][p] New item: Flare. Can be thrown and ignited to provide light. Max stack 4. Spawns randomly in regular containers.
[/p][/*][*][p] New item: Ballistic Shield. Blocks gunshots and melee from the front but does not block alien attacks.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Changes:[/b]

[/p][list][*][p] Temporarily removed rooms without unique properties: Silo, Maintenance, Living Quarters B, Warehouse, Research A and Research B.
[/p][/*][*][p] The Psycho Knife now grants a small movement speed bonus when held.
[/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]QOL & Polish:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Items that can be used multiple times such as mines and flares now have a counter similar to the ammo counter with firearms. [/p][/*][*][p] Added visible error messages to main menu when getting disconnected or joining a lobby fails.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Fixes :[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Fixed the progress slider not animating when dragging an item from a container to hotbar.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Time Bomb not always damaging players.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where clients did not have all room connections visible in the Crewnet Admin view.
[/p][/*][*][p] Enemy behaviour fixes.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed dead bodies dropping their ammo twice if the dead player disconnects.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: PLAYTEST BUILD 0.8.32.1 | Foundry rework, QOL & polish.
notes.content:
Hi!

While we are still gathering more feedback and data, here's a nice little patch to improve your experience with the playtest. Next on the roadmap is a demo release, that will bring more content to the game.

[b]New content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked Foundry room.
[*] Added a post-game scoreboard.
[*] You can now drop ammo that has been added to the ammo pouch.
[*] You can now set a tag for the language of your lobby that is visible to others in the server browser. Added a few language options.
[/list]

[b]QOL and polish:[/b]
[list]
[*] If you have an empty slot of the correct type in your Hotbar, hold the interaction key to immediately equip a dropped item instead of placing it in your inventory.
[*] You can now adjust volumes for individual players in the lobby.
[*] Added a key bind for quickly toggling the Disguiser item on and off.
[*] Added a confirmation dialog for leaving and quitting the game.
[*] Improved the logic of displaying the ghost model when trying to plant mines, bombs and jammers. Now you don’t need to press the set position button again if the ghost indicator disappears because the surface you were looking at was not a valid surface for planting objects.
[*] Added tips and hints to the transition screen.
[*] the UI now supports 4:3 resolutions.
[*] Added music to the main menu.
[*] Added more missing sound effects.
[*] The player’s team is now shown at the center of the screen at start of a round.
[*] The objectives list, hints and team indicator are now shown one at a time at start of the round, instead of everything at once.
[*] Changes and additions to room decorations.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reload animations are no longer interrupted with objects blocking the barrel. (Visual bug)
[*] Travelling through wormholes is now client authorative, so there’s no small delay before teleporting.
[*] Fixed Auto Turrets not engaging the Snatcher enemies
[*] Fixed items dropped on the conveyor belt not moving.
[*] Fixed some visual settings sliders in main menu not loading correct values.
[*] Fixed players being able to plant bombs and jammers inside that one type of desk.
[*] Fixed some bugs with item specific movement speed modifiers.
[*] Fixed some camera jitters in certain situations.
[*] Fixed positioning of status effects icons such as Psycho Killer damage resistance, handcuffs and the disguiser in player inventory. 
[*] Fixed the EVAC ship not crushing enemies when landing.
[*] Optimized alarm lights.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the chance of Auto Turret to drop its weapon when knocked over from 30% to 15%
[*] Slightly reduced the movement speed penalties of some firearms.
[*] Wormholes now have an initial 30% chance to spawn that is increased by 5% for each player participating in the round.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest round 2
notes.content:
The second playtest is online right now. Traitors are no more the only thing the crew needs watch out for, as this version introduces monsters and other hazards that may be spell doom to careless space engineers. Traitors will also need to be careful, as these dangers do not discriminate based on teams.

Thanks for the feedback you've given so far. It's been really valuable and I've already implemented some of your suggestions, such as the option for open microphone.

Here are the full patch notes:

[h1]0.7.23.4[/h1]

[b]Known issues[/b]
Friends cannot see your lobby in the server browser when setting the lobby visibility option to "Friends". However, friends can still join your lobby on their own using the Steam friend list, or by accepting your invites.

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added three enemies with different behaviors. A small one and two big ones.
[*] Added an option for open mic.
[*] Added a new hazard: Auto Turret.
[*] Added new firearm, Reibel, a Medium Ammo LMG used by Auto Turrets.	
[*] Added a new hazard: Bounce Mines.
[*] Added a new item: Door UNJammer, single use item that can open a jammed door instantly.
[*] Added a new EVAC event: Alien Horde. More enemies are spawned between the EVAC ship and Communication room. Make sure you are ready before starting the EVAC!
[*] Added a chance for two simultaneous EVAC events to proc.
[*] Added a new EVAC Event: Chaos Rift.
[*] Added a Bank to Crewnet. The bank tab can be used to transfer funds to other players.
[*] If you are alive and the round ends with a player dying, the camera now jumps to the dying player.
[*] Added role breakdown and a score summary to end of round.
[*] M16 can now be toggled between burst and semi-auto, is semi by default.
[*] All firearms now have dots on the HUD below ammo counter indicating the fire mode.
[*] Added UI icons and visualizations to signal who is speaking.
[*] Added a panel that shows weapon stats and wrote descriptions for all weapons.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed dead players inside the EVAC ship counting for Crew victory.
[*] Improved performance.
[*] Fixed a bug where adding ammo to pouch that became full used the whole stack from your inventory instead of reducing it.
[*] Fixed the Hangar gate not always knocking players down on collision.
[*] Fixed uncompleted objectives sometimes disappearing from the objectives list.
[*] Fixed EVAC ship not crushing players when landing.
[*] Fixed Armory being named Assembly on a room map.
[*] Fixed a bug where gain keycard access objective would proc when walking through a different door.
[*] Fixed some spectator camera issues in lobby before a match was started.
[*] Fixed the minimap being visible for spectator before a round started.
[*] Camera rotation is a bit smoother now.
[*] The status of doors are now synced for mid game joiners.
[*] Fixed razor wire blocking bullets.
[*] Fixed some hit detection issues while planting Razor Mines.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Communications and supply room names are now only visible on upgraded GPSs.
[*] The teams of dead players are no longer revealed when searching their bodies by default (new server setting)
[*] Firearms now come with a movement speed penalty when held based on their size/weight.
[*] Some rooms have had their layout adjusted.
[*] Automatic doors are now operated manually.
[*] Impacts when ragdolled now do damage.
[*] EVAC events are now announced on the HUD.
[*] Basic melee weapons are now spawned on tables in Hangar every round.
[*] Added more spawn positions for Safes and increased the default amount of Safes to spawn per player. 
[*] Increased the default amount of firearms that spawn per player.
[*] Reduced the ammo pouch capacity for all ammo types.
[*] Shots on legs (not thighs) now slow players momentarily. 
[*] Reduced the slow amount and duration of barbed wire from Razor Mines.
[*] Reduced the stack of Razor Mines you get when buying to 2.
[*] If you were running when opening menu or container, you will not enter walk mode anymore when exiting.
[*] Some UI changes.
[*] Improved some visuals.
[/list]

As with the previous round of playtest, please answer this short 
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeSBm7krXvQTwhEmfzSVf1266wk-LEJ9vnVoGB9MsBgJeezIg/viewform?usp=dialog]Google form[/url] (requires sign-in) after playing, thanks! Please answer again even if you filled out the form in the previous playtest.

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/qqcMyYENnG]Discord server[/url] to stay in the loop, give suggestions, and report bugs.

notes.title: PLAYTEST BUILD 0.6.15.2 | Improved hints and objectives
notes.content:
Hi! 
Thanks to your feedback, I've noticed some hint messages and objectives were not clear enough.
I've updated the objective texts and hint messages to be more descriptive and added some new ones. Also, there's some new info posters in Hangar and some other rooms. 

Furthermore, the your feedback regarding the size of the map has been almost unanimous.
The default size of the map (room increase per player) has been halved.

Here's the full patch notes:

New Content:
•	The name of the current room you are in is now visible on the HUD

Fixes
•	Fixed Chaos Gate sometimes teleporting you outside of rooms.

Changes
•	Decreased the default value of how much the map increases in size (room amount) with each 
player, resulting in smaller maps. This means with parties consisting of less than 8 players, the station will only branch out into two wings from the Hangar. Like previously, the host can change this value from the Round Settings panel.
•	Added several new hint messages and improved old ones.
•	Finding doors locked with keycards now give objectives for crafting keycards.
•	Being at the office when a keycard is crafted now gives an objective for unlocking the correct door.
•	Crewnet Terminals now have a little info window on each tab describing their function.
•	Added a few info posters to Hangar and some other rooms.
•	Spectator camera now only targets alive players.
•	Increased Proximity Mine damage over the kill threshold.
•	Increased the shop sell quantity of Razor Mines from 3 to 4.

notes.title: Welcome to the Playtest!
notes.content:
Hi!

-Wandering Wavelengths
